subject.title: [security] Orgo client replays command bodies across origins and Bearer tokens to subdomains

question: Should Crabbox enforce the documented same-origin credentialed-redirect boundary in the Orgo provider with a cloned client and a strict same-scheme/host/effective-port redirect policy?
rationale: The implementation is bounded, but the exact redirect compatibility contract, callback composition, and rejected-error redaction define a security boundary that should be explicitly approved by a repository security owner.

options.title: Approve provider-scoped redirect guard
options.body: Adopt the proposed cloned-client guard with focused body, credential, callback, hop-limit, and error-redaction tests.

options.title: Document a narrower exception
options.body: Retain a specific compatible redirect case only if maintainers can state why it remains safe for credentialed command requests.

options.title: Pause for security validation
options.body: Request an independent reproduction and provider compatibility assessment before selecting the permanent redirect contract.

recommendation.title: Approve provider-scoped redirect guard
recommendation.body: Adopt the proposed cloned-client guard with focused body, credential, callback, hop-limit, and error-redaction tests.

likelyOwner.reason: The reporter has the most concrete available analysis of the affected call path, though a repository security owner should make the final boundary decision.
